<script setup lang="ts">
import { Primitive, type PrimitiveProps } from '../../primitive'
import { breadcrumbLinkVariants, cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<PrimitiveProps & { class?: HTMLAttributes['class'] }>(), {
  as: 'a',
})
</script>

<template>
  <Primitive
    :as="as"
    :as-child="asChild"
    data-slot="breadcrumb-link"
    :class="cn(breadcrumbLinkVariants(), props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </Primitive>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

const props = defineProps<{
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
}>()
</script>

<template>
  <nav aria-label="breadcrumb" data-slot="breadcrumb" :class="cn(props.class)">
    <slot />
  </nav>
</template>

1. Home
  3. Breadcrumb

<view class="{{className}} breadcrumb">
  <block wx:for="{{items}}" wx:key="index">
    <view 
      class="breadcrumb-item"
      data-index="{{index}}"
      bindtap="onItemTap"
      data-current="{{index === items.length - 1}}"
    >
      <text class="breadcrumb-link">{{item.label || item}}</text>
    </view>
    <text 
      wx:if="{{index < items.length - 1}}" 
      class="breadcrumb-separator"
    >
      {{separator}}
    </text>
  </block>
</view>

<view class="{{className}}" data-slot="breadcrumb-ellipsis" role="presentation" aria-hidden="true">
  <slot>
    <svg
      width="16"
      height="16"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      stroke-width="2"
      stroke-linecap="round"
      stroke-linejoin="round"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <circle cx="5" cy="12" r="1.5" />
      <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="1.5" />
      <circle cx="19" cy="12" r="1.5" />
    </svg>
  </slot>
  <text class="sr-only">More</text>
</view>

<view class="{{className}}" data-slot="breadcrumb-item">
  <slot></slot>
</view>

<view class="{{className}}" data-slot="breadcrumb-link">
  <slot></slot>
</view>

<view class="{{className}}" data-slot="breadcrumb-list">
  <slot></slot>
</view>

<view class="{{className}}" data-slot="breadcrumb-page">
  <slot></slot>
</view>

<view class="{{className}}" data-slot="breadcrumb-separator" role="presentation" aria-hidden="true">
  <slot>
    <svg
      width="16"
      height="16"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      stroke-width="2"
      stroke-linecap="round"
      stroke-linejoin="round"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <path d="m9 18 6-6-6-6" />
    </svg>
  </slot>
</view>
